documentation.file_docstring: Storage provider interface for report uploads. Defines the contract for local, S3, and Azure Blob storage implementations.
inline_comments: Storage provider contract for uploading governance reports. All implementations must validate credentials on every upload (zero-trust).
Validate credentials before upload. @throws CredentialError if credentials are missing, invalid, or expired.

Upload HTML content to storage. @param html - The HTML content to upload. @param filename - Desired filename for the upload. @returns Upload result with URL and expiration. @throws CredentialError if credentials fail validation.
Configure provider-specific settings. @param settings - Key-value settings for the provider.
